description: Napa, CA – On Friday, October 7th at 5:00 pm Rep. Mike Thompson will host a Service Academies Information Night. Rep. Thompson will be joined by representatives from the U.S. Military Academy, the U.S. Naval Academy, the U.S. Air Force Academy, U.S. Merchant Marine Academy, and the U.S. Coast Guard.
